meta.title: Agent-Ticker subscription map baseline
meta.scope: Individual paid subscriptions only; products are listed as benefits of their plan. No free, team, enterprise, standalone Cursor, or API-only plans. Listed prices are standard public web rates, not promotional or app-store quotes; EU examples are country-specific.
meta.audience: Vibe coders first; business decision-makers second.

status_definitions.verified: Official sources state this benefit or buying term.
status_definitions.conditional: Availability, allowance, rollout or legacy plan varies, or the cell combines verified statements with explicitly named unknowns.
status_definitions.not included: Official source explicitly excludes the feature for the whole cell.
status_definitions.not checked: No cell-level claim was verified; the URL is the official starting point.

meta.eu_note_null: No specific EU qualification asserted; not a guarantee of feature availability.

feature_definitions.always_on_agent: Can start scheduled work without an open user session; remote access or a one-off cloud run alone does not qualify.

claude.value: US web: Pro USD $20/mo or $200/yr; Max $100/mo; Ultra $200/mo. Local pricing may differ; EU amount not checked.
claude.eu_note: Anthropic says Pro pricing varies by country and local currency where supported; no fixed EU-wide quote verified.
claude.note: Max is the former Max 5×; Ultra replaces Max 20× without a price change.

chatgpt.value: US web: Go USD $8/mo, Plus $20/mo, Pro $100/$200/$500 per month. EEA bills in EUR; exact local rates not checked.
chatgpt.eu_note: OpenAI lists EUR billing for the EEA; the cited pages do not give EEA tier prices.

grok.value: New X Subscription (USD, pre-tax): Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200/mo; $80/$300/$1,000/$2,000/yr. Legacy renewals and EUR quotes not checked.
grok.eu_note: List prices exclude applicable VAT; EU checkout prices not checked.
grok.note: New self-serve customers start on The X Subscription. Existing SuperGrok and X Premium plans continue; account holders may switch. Legacy includes SuperGrok Lite, SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy and X Premium+; this cell does not quote their individual renewal prices.

devin.value: Pro USD $20/mo; Max USD $200/mo. EUR quote not checked.

gemini.eu_note: Germany amounts listed in tier order; Ireland lists AI Plus €4.99/mo and the same Pro and Ultra prices. These are local examples, not EU-wide quotes.

claude.value: Mixed: flat subscription plus optional usage credits at API rates; Pro pays from first Fable use outside promotions.
claude.note: Model usage credits are distinct from the Max and Ultra monthly API-credit benefit.

chatgpt.value: Mixed on Plus/Pro: monthly fee plus optional credits for eligible overage. Go: monthly fee; overage credits only for selected accounts.
chatgpt.note: Credits are not API credits. Eligible Plus/Pro accounts can also buy an instant allowance reset; availability varies by billing country.

grok.value: Mixed: subscription plus prepaid top-ups past the weekly pool; third-party coding models are charged separately from first use.
grok.note: Third-party model rule applies to the bundled coding editor. Legacy SuperGrok also documents optional pay-as-you-go after included usage.

devin.value: Mixed: monthly fee with a usage allowance; optional prepaid overage credits billed at API rates.

gemini.value: AI Plus: flat fee for the core AI allowance; Pro/Ultra: mixed, with optional purchased AI credits after included usage.
gemini.note: Google says AI Plus cannot buy general Google One AI credits; separate product-specific credit systems (e.g. Flow Music) are not the general AI-credit balance.

claude.value: Chat + Code share caps: Pro 5-hour/weekly; Max 5× Pro in both; Ultra 10× weekly, no 5-hour cap once verified. Fable: up to half the weekly bucket on Max/Ultra.
claude.note: Unverified Ultra accounts have a temporary 5-hour cap; task size, model and context change how quickly usage burns.

chatgpt.value: Go: limited Codex; Plus: 5-hour and weekly Work/Codex caps; Pro: weekly allowance, currently no 5-hour Work/Codex cap. Chat caps are separate.
chatgpt.note: Work/Codex use varies by task, model and settings. Pro 100/200/500 have different allowances; no single fixed message count applies. Go does not include Codex Cloud.

grok.value: Shared weekly pool: Plus base, Premium 4×, Super 15×, Ultra 50×. Legacy SuperGrok also has a weekly pool; exact legacy allotments not checked.
grok.note: New pool is shared across eligible bundled tools, including Grok Bot where included. These are usage ratios, not message counts.

devin.value: Pro: daily and weekly caps. Max: larger weekly allowance, no daily cap. Desktop, CLI and cloud draw from the same pool.
devin.note: Public plan docs do not give fixed per-plan token or task totals.

gemini.value: Gemini app usage: AI Plus 2× and Pro 4× standard; Ultra 5× or 20× Pro. Antigravity has its own limits.
gemini.note: Ratios are not fixed prompt counts; request complexity, feature and model affect usage.

claude.value: Fable 5.2: pay-as-you-go credits on Pro; included up to half the weekly limit on Max/Ultra. Opus included on all three.
claude.note: Ignores temporary launch offers; update Claude Code for Fable 5.2.

chatgpt.value: Go: GPT-5.6 Luna in Chat; Plus: GPT-6.2 reasoning where rolled out; Pro: GPT-6 Pro in Chat and GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol in eligible Work/Codex.
chatgpt.note: Model choices vary by account and surface. Pro $200 has GPT-6.2 Sol Ultrafast in Codex only; Pro $500 offers GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol Ultrafast. Plus can have limited Astra usage in Work/Codex; check the model picker.

grok.value: Premium/Super/Ultra promise the latest Grok models; Grok 4.7 is documented for Build. Exact Chat model access by tier and legacy plan: not checked.
grok.note: Don't infer chat access from the API catalog or the Build rollout. Grok Bot routes models itself; there is no picker.

devin.value: Pro/Max: frontier model picker and SWE-2.1 in Desktop/CLI; SWE-2.1 in cloud is a time-limited preview.
devin.note: Cloud SWE-2.1 preview documented through December 22, 2026. The Desktop and cloud catalogs differ.

gemini.value: Gemini app: Plus gets 4 Hydrogen, Pro gets 4 Neon, Ultra gets 4 Carbon. Paid Pro also gets Carbon in Antigravity.
gemini.note: Highest documented selectable model per tier in Gemini Apps; Search AI Mode and Antigravity have separate entitlements.

claude.value: All three include Claude Code: local terminal, IDE or Desktop; cloud work from web, Desktop or mobile.

chatgpt.value: Codex local CLI/IDE/desktop on Go, Plus and Pro; Codex Cloud on eligible Plus and all Pro tiers, not Go.

grok.value: Grok Build runs in your terminal on every new X tier; cloud coding agents on Premium+. Legacy Build entitlements by tier not checked.
grok.note: The X Subscription inherently bundles Cursor; no standalone Cursor subscription is mapped. Grok Build supports macOS/Linux and Windows shells.

devin.value: Pro and Max: local Devin CLI/Desktop agents; delegate to Devin's cloud machine from web or Desktop.
devin.note: Devin Cloud access in Desktop is documented as rolling out gradually.

gemini.value: Antigravity desktop/IDE + CLI; Google-hosted Remote Agents roll out to Pro/Ultra, not Plus.

claude.value: Pro, Max and Ultra: Claude Code cloud scheduled tasks run without an open session.
claude.note: Cloud runs draw from account usage; local scheduled tasks are separate.

chatgpt.value: ChatGPT Scheduled: Go 3, Plus 5, Pro 15 active tasks; Plus/Pro get eligible app triggers. The separate Plus dot pilot is not in the EU/EEA.
chatgpt.eu_note: The separate dot pilot for select Plus users excludes the EEA (including the EU), UK and Switzerland. That exclusion does not establish a restriction on ordinary ChatGPT Scheduled tasks.
chatgpt.note: Scheduled one-off and recurring tasks are account/app dependent. Use a cloud-capable task, not a task that runs only on your computer. Go does not include event-triggered tasks.

grok.value: Grok Bot runs cloud routines on Premium/Super/Ultra, not Plus. Legacy SuperGrok, Plus, Heavy and X Premium+ need account linking; Lite can't link.
grok.note: Legacy 'Plus' in the second sentence means SuperGrok Plus, not The X Subscription Plus.

devin.value: Pro/Max: scheduled Automations start cloud sessions. Max adds Devin Bots that can own recurring work.
devin.note: Automations and Devin Bots are distinct. Runs depend on usage balance and connected tools as applicable.

gemini.value: Gemini Tasks runs background schedules in eligible countries (not EU/EEA). Separate in-chat scheduled actions run in the background, with rollout availability.
gemini.eu_note: Tasks in Gemini is unavailable in the EEA (incl. EU), Nigeria, Switzerland and the UK. Google’s separate in-chat schedules page does not give an EEA-specific availability guarantee.
gemini.note: In eligible markets Pro/Ultra get time-, Gmail- and topic-triggered Tasks schedules; Plus uses a daily time window where the feature is otherwise available. Antigravity has separate background automations; offline device requirements not checked here.
